stateAndHttpSafety: DQA-UI05: protected UI requests retain same-origin JSON fetch with CSRF, redirect:error and allowed status/content-type/strict-shape checking. Successful navigation is HTTP200 NavigationEnvelope with an unconsumed allowlisted relative ticket URL, followed by exactly one client GET; Login alone retains native form POST success303.

Validation/confirmation/conflict/auth/DB-error JSON never replaces current DOM/raw/tab/selection with a POST HTML document. The GET URL remains current, so reload cannot resend Save. Unknown redirect/HTML/JSON and transport failures do not retry automatically.

Full payload remains JSON under the existing 2MiB body limit; it is not wrapped in one form value subject to 16384 length. Existing scalar, strict shape, depth16 and business validation limits remain distinct.
SearchRaw uses dedicated raw binding without trimming or empty-to-null conversion. SearchCriteria is validated only by explicit search; applied-null differs from all-fields-null valid full search.
New/cancel/approved discard accept technically valid raw without business number/date/required/candidate validation. Untouched New cancel is not forced through save or HTML validation.

ApplyRawSnapshot compares all four raw values ordinally on Open/Export and first makes changed conditions Unapplied/results invalid. New can continue; Edit/Export reject invalid results. Old seq/revision responses cannot revive stale selection.

Session/Tab/State/DocumentLease and one-time 60-second NavigationTicket stay within existing ScreenStateStore. Direct/duplicate displays create independent live state and edit draft; original live state is unchanged.

SearchResumeRef stores immutable search-only snapshots in existing Store, not edit drafts or mutable live state. History holds opaque ref/source Tab only, with current authentication and expiry checks; copied reference yields independent state.

F03 persisted BFCache restoration checks valid search-only reference, disables UI, performs at most one new GET and resume before enabling controls. Existing F04/F06 input, failed save or Unknown is not automatically replaced.
Known committed save plus ticket/redirect failure remains saved + display transfer failure, never automatic save retry. Unknown keeps existing MSG-034, CanSave=false and current-value verification.

MSG-041 applies to authenticated UI-state/lease expiry only; current authorization/ownership and authentication-expiry MSG-002 remain higher priority. Failed explicit reread keeps old input/target and CanSave=false.

App confirmation has concrete discard/continue labels, safe initial focus and Escape, original MSG branches and scope. Browser warning limitations remain explicit; no automatic save or localStorage draft recovery.

findings.issue: Protected fetch303 could consume the one-use ticket before client navigation; native form POST error pages could resend on reload and a one-field JSON wrapper would violate the per-value16384 bound.
findings.resolution: One protected transport only: CSRF JSON fetch with redirect:error, strict JSON status/content-type/shape checks, HTTP200 NavigationEnvelope containing unconsumed allowlisted ticket URL and one client GET. Errors/confirmation keep current DOM/GET URL; no retry and Committed/Unknown are distinct. Login native303 retained. Six changed candidate documents are newly reviewed and hashed; no product observation used to adjust expected values.
